questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Golden Smith book shop

Regular Customers

Joyful Readers

Dec 1st 13:10
Dear Loyal Customers,

Thanks for your purchase at Golden Smith book shop. We hope that all the books bought and any customized services received at our store were satisfactory. From the current year, when customers turn in their completed registration cards, the date of purchase and personal information will be automatically recorded and used to sign up for a membership in our Joyful Reader program. If you have further inquiries about membership, please let us know by phone, fax, letter or e-mail. Thank you for shopping with us.
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer of the Golden Smith book shop. In your e-mail, describe ONE problem that you have experienced so far and make TWO questions about the Joyful Reader program.
questions.model_answer:
To Golden Smith book shop, Lời chào
Thanks for your e-mail. I am writing this e-mail in regards to the membership program, Joyful Reader. Up until now, your store didn't have a policy of giving customers a discount on fairly large purchases (vấn đề), which was a deterrent to visiting your store. As a regular patron, I think the Joyful Reader program is a welcome change. However, I have some concerns. Am I expected to pay a membership fee (câu hỏi 1)? I would prefer it free of charge, obviously. And, can you list all the benefits, most importantly, any possible discounts on book purchases (câu hỏi 2)? Your answers to these questions will be much appreciated. - Vấn đề: Tiệm sách chưa bao giờ có giảm giá khách hàng mua nhiều sản phẩm. Việc có chương trình này là một thay đổi tốt - Câu hỏi: + Có cần phải trả phí thành viên không? + Bạn có thể liệt kê các lợi ích, giảm giá cho việc mua sách được không?
Thank you.   Best wishes, Terry McLean Ký tên

questions.question:
FROM:

TO:

SUBJECT:

SENT:

 Pam Hadis

James Carter, Human Resources Department

Job Request

October 10, 9:53 A.M.
Dear Mr. Carter,

My name is Pam Hadis, and I am very much interested in applying for a job at Golden Tree Enterprises. I understand that your company usually posts job openings at the end of the year, but I would really appreciate it if you would send me information about upcoming jobs before making it public. I am available for an interview at any time. An early reply would be greatly appreciated.

Sincerely,

Pam Hadis
Directions: Respond to the e-mail as if you are James Carter. In your e-mail, tell her at least ONE reason why you refuse to comply with her request and give TWO pieces of information.
questions.model_answer:
Dear Ms. Hadis, Lời chào
First of all, I'm very pleased to receive your e-mail and thank for your interest in applying at Golden Tree. I'm writing in relation to your recent request. I understand that you wish to receive the annual job listings before anyone else. I'm awfully sorry, but there is nothing I can do for you, because it wouldn't be fair to the other applicants (lý do). However, I can let you know that we will post the list one month ahead of the usual time (thông tin 1). Also, you can access additional information about the list on our official website (thông tin 2). If you want to see me, I'm available on the first Thursday of November (thông tin 3).   - Lý do từ chối: nó sẽ không công bằng với những ứng viên khác - Thông tin: + Chúng tôi sẽ đăng danh sách 1 tháng trước thời gian bình thường + Bạn có thể đọc thêm thông tin về danh sách trên website + Nếu bạn muốn gặp tôi tôi có mặt vào thứ 5 đầu tiên của tháng 11
Sincerely, James Carter Ký tên

questions.question: To lead a business to success, there are many things to consider. What do you think are the main factors in running a successful business? Give specific reasons and examples.
questions.model_answer:
Mở bài Running a business is what a lot of people hope to do, but a lot of businesses fail every day. Among the many things that people have to consider when running a successful business, I would like to mention the two most important factors: marketing and a customer-oriented approach. Nêu rõ 2 luận điểm sẽ triển khai: marketing và cách tiếp cận hướng tới khách hàng
Thân bài 1 (Marketing) Let's define the scope of marketing. What does "market a product" mean? It means you have to promote your products to boost sales, which involves knowing how to package your products, how to advertise them, how to define the terms and conditions when selling them, and some other minor details that come up along the way. When I was working as a manager at an upscale clothing store, I realized that having well-made fancy clothing was only part of the many steps needed to raise revenue. What mattered more than the product itself was the whole process of marketing. Clothes had to be sold to customers in a shiny bag with a luxurious look. We had to advertise our clothes through flyers, daily newspapers, and even TV. When customers finally decided to buy our products, we had to offer mutually beneficial conditions, for instance, a fair warranty and returns policy - Phân tích: Marketing nghĩa là xúc tiến để doanh số bán hàng tăng lên, cách đóng gói sản phẩm, cách quảng cáo, các điều khoản và các chi tiết nhỏ. - Ví dụ: Khi tôi làm ở một cửa hàng quần áo cao cấp, tôi nhận ra là có quần áo xa xỉ chỉ là một phần trong nhiều bước để tăng doanh thu. Marketing rất quan trọng, quần áo cần được bán trong túi sáng và sang trọng. Cần quảng cáo trên tờ rơi, báo, TV. Chúng ta cần cung cấp lợi ích đôi bên, như chính sách bảo hành và trả hàng tốt.
Thân bài 2 (Cách tiếp cận hướng tới khách hàng) The second factor to running a successful business is to adopt a customer-oriented approach. When you are selling goods or services, think about what it would be like to buy your products from a customer's point of view. Develop a strategy to turn anybody visiting your store into a loyal customer. If I were a customer, what would I want from a merchant? Is it just a product or is it something more that comes with the product without any further cost? These are some of the questions you must ask yourself when you focus on customers' needs. This mindset also applies to people in manufacturing. What kind of style will appeal to customers? What is the thing that your customers are looking for in a product? These questions must be kept in mind by everyone in the company. - Phân tích: Điều này nghĩa là cần phải nghĩ ở góc độ khách hàng. Cần có chiến thuật biến mọi người tới cửa hàng thành khách hàng trung thành. Cần đặt ra các câu hỏi như tôi cần gì từ một người bán, nó là sản phẩm hay cái gì đó đi kèm thêm mà không mấy thêm tiền. Những nhà sản xuất hàng cũng cần nghĩ khách hàng thích phong cách nào, khách hàng đang tìm gì ở sản phẩm.
Kết bài Running a successful business is not an easy task as the competition in the marketplace becomes intense. However, by implementing the right marketing strategies and having a customer-oriented approach, your business should prosper. Tổng hợp, nhắc lại về 2 điều quan trọng với doanh nghiệp

intro.content:
Question 1-5: Write a sentence based on a picture

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write ONE sentence that is based on a picture. With each picture, you will be given TWO words or phrases that you must use in your sentence. You can change the forms of the words and you can use the words in any order. Your sentences will be scored on

  • the appropriate use of grammar and
  • the relevance of the sentence to the picture

In this part, you can move to the next question by clicking on Next. If you want to return to a previous question, click on Back. You will have 8 minutes to complete this part of the test.

Example

 Sample response: This man is writing in a notebook.

Question 6-7: Respond to a written request

Directions: In this part of the test, you will show how well you can write a response to an e-mail.

Your response will be scored on

  • the quality and variety of your sentence,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 10 minutes to read and answer each e-mail

Click on Continue to go on.

Question 8: Write an opinion essay

Directions: In this part of the test, you will write an essay in response to a question that asks you to state, explain, and support your opinion on an issue. Typically, an effective essay will contain a minimum of 300 words. Your response will be scored on

  • whether your opinion is supported with reasons and/or examples.
  • grammar,
  • vocabulary, and
  • organization.

You will have 30 minutes to plan, write, and revise your essay.

Click on Continue to go on.
